name: chess-bishop
description: A complete chess bishop with a diagonal mitre slit and broad base.
useCase: Choose or identify a bishop in a chess interface.
misuse: Pair this symbol with a clear label when its meaning depends on context.

16.reason: The complete mitre, diagonal slit, tapered stem and broad base remain intact, with both stem roots contained in the lower head contour.

24.reason: The larger bishop retains its complete mitre, diagonal slit, tapered stem and open base, with both stem roots contained in the lower head contour.
